capabilities: Run the Antigravity CLI in an Obsidian sidebar pane
Interact with a full terminal (typing, scrolling, resizing) via xterm.js
Customize the CLI command path and default launch arguments
Migrate settings automatically from the older Gemini CLI version
Launch from a ribbon icon or the command palette
extras: Desktop-only (uses Node.js child_process; no mobile support). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Default arguments include --dangerously-skip-permissions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run an external AI CLI agent in a pane; you would have to switch to a separate terminal app.

relations.evidence: embeds Antigravity CLI directly into a sidebar pane
Since Google is deprecating/shutting down Gemini CLI, V2.0 has been fully migrated

summary: Sidebar terminal that embeds the Antigravity CLI (agy) inside Obsidian so you can chat with it without leaving your notes.
